 - An epic campaign and a story that keeps you glued to the edge of your seat from start to finish.
 - Call of Duty's signature Multiplayer gameplay with deeper levels of character customization, and all new modes like Wager Matches, the Theater, and Combat Training which can be played Solo or Co-Op. 
 - Zombies! Providing endless hours of intense Zombie-slaying entertainment, Solo or Co-Op.

-Enjoy thousands of unique puzzles which stay true to the original TV Show. 
-Compete with your friends and family online and try to reach the top of the leaderboards.
-Progress through the game by unlocking all the rewards, leveling up and collecting all the souvenirs.
Wheel of Fortune offers both the original TV show‘s DNA as well as unique and new features for both veteran players and new players alike.
